# Carolyn Labey

Carolyn Labey is the current Deputy of [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2002.

Carolyn Labey has participated in 7 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e3)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville with 65.9% of the vote.
- [**2005 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e7)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville unopposed.
- [**2008 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e12)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville unopposed.
- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e15)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville with 55.9% of the vote.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111016142512/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/grouville/carolyn-labey/)
  - [2011 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20110928080037/http://www.channel103.com:80/election/?page_id=91)
- [**2014 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e20)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville unopposed.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/carolyn-labey-3/)
- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e42)

  Elected as Deputy of Grouville unopposed.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/carolyn-labey-2/)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/carolyn-labey#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 9 with 63.7% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/carolyn-labey/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fcJbLTU0wLs)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220820124930/https://carolynlabey.je/manifesto/)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=8)

Carolyn Labey has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 9](https://flow.je/elections/district-9). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/09/long-serving-deputy-to-stand-again/)\]

## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [Grouville](https://flow.je/elections/grouville) (1 seat), 27th November 2002.

**Carolyn Labey was elected as Deputy of Grouville in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Carolyn Labey** |  | 774 | 65.9% |
| 2 | [Patricia Picot](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/patricia-anne-picot) |  | 397 | 33.8% |

1,175 votes (inc. 4 spoilt papers)

2,852 registered voters

= 41.2% turnout
